name: Emissions selection — supplier actual data at high confidence, never marked up
why: The mark-up exists to make collecting real supplier data cheaper than falling back to a default. Applying it to actual data would invert that incentive and overstate a declarant who did the right thing. This case pins the actual path staying at the supplier's own figures with a zero mark-up, which is the property that makes the default case above safe to change independently.

decision_trace.detail: Actual direct value passed plausibility check against Annex VI default.
Both direct and indirect supplier values accepted. Method = actual.
